name: Argyll
description: Argyle: a field of solid diamonds in mixed colors, crossed corner to corner by a fine overcheck that runs through every one.

code.style: --rule: ( --f: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background-color: @var(--f); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: var(--color6); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 2.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 48.0%, 98.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 2.0%, 52.0% 50.0%, 100.0% 98.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 98.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 52.0%, 2.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 98.0%, 48.0% 50.0%, 0.0% 2.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 2.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 48.0%, 98.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 2.0%, 52.0% 50.0%, 100.0% 98.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 98.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 52.0%, 2.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 98.0%, 48.0% 50.0%, 0.0% 2.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
